messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Nova Q4 POC. Need to lock integration windows and confirm owners. Main items: webhook callback, S3 ingest, VPC peering, RBAC for embeddings pipeline. Proposed customer test windows: 2024-10-14 to 2024-10-18 (dry run), 2024-10-21 to 2024-10-25 (live).

Jon: SEs asked for a final API spec. I have PR #452 on the spec; need Eng review. @Priya can you take a look? Link: https://git.redwood.dev/r/specs/pulls/452

Priya: Looking now. Will leave comments by EOD PDT. Are we doing hosted infra or Dedicated for the live window? This changes latency expectations and rollback plan.

Ken: Customer insists on Dedicated capacity for SLA. Ops: can we reserve a 2-GPU pool for Oct21-25? @Zach please confirm network readiness.

Zach: VPC peering scheduled 10/19 in my calendar; need customer's subnet CIDR. Also we'll need port 9000 opened to the customer's IPs. @Maya send CIDR and security contact.

Maya: Sent CIDR to SE team just now. Also attaching quick checklist: - PR #452 review - Infra reservation ticket (ops-987) - E2E tests in staging - Data deletion policy signed. Customer success needs success criteria: 95% inference within 150ms median, <2% error rate.

Jon: Noted. I'll ping SEs for success criteria sign-off. Also quick CR ping: @Priya can you LGTM PR #452 if no blockers?

Priya: Will do after reviewing tests. Two questions: 1) Are we enabling prefix caching? 2) Which model variant to use — redwood/longlite-3B or redwood/long-7B-quant?

Maya: For cost and latency pick longlite-3B for dry runs, switch to long-7B-quant for live if latency holds. Prefix caching ON for all runs. Document in ops-987.

Ken: Ops can reserve 2 GPUs for live and 1 for dry run. Filing ops-987 now.

DeployBot: Reminder: calendar slot clash detected for 10/21 09:00-11:00 with platform maintenance. @Ken can you confirm maintenance window or request rollback?

Ken: Thanks DeployBot. I'll coordinate with infra; can shift maintenance to 10/21 02:00-04:00 instead.

Zach: Confirmed peering can be completed 10/19 after customer adds route. I'll add network runbook to the thread.

Maya: Final ask — owners for E2E smoke tests? @Jon for test harness, @Priya for test cases, @Zach for infra checks. Anyone else taking on post-POC cleanup (data deletion + audit)?

Jon: I'll own harness + test infra. Assigning post-POC cleanup to Ken for data deletion audit.

Priya: LGTM on PR #452 — left one minor doc nit. Running tests tonight.

Maya: Great. I'll update the shared tracker and ping the SEs for final acceptance criteria. Thanks team :thumbsup:
